    Load example species parameters

    get_example_spdat.Rd

    Retrieves the species-specific energetics, demography, and prey parameters used by the package's Kittiwake example.

    Usage

    get_example_spdat()

    Value

    A data frame containing the species-specific parameters for Kittiwake, identified by species code "KI".

    Details

    This function calls get_spdat("KI") to retrieve the Kittiwake parameters from the species-parameter data supplied with the package.

    The returned object can be supplied as the spdat argument to seabord().

    See the package input vignette for an example: vignette("C_KI_inputs", package = "seabORD").

    See also

    get_spdat() and seabord().

    Other example data: get_example_DBS_map(), get_example_ORDpoly(), get_example_fgc_3035(), get_example_fltdist_base(), get_example_frgcompdata(), get_example_modpar(), get_example_ordPar(), get_example_output(), get_example_par(), get_example_seamask(), get_example_spadat1(), get_example_spadat2(), get_example_switches()

    Examples

    # Load the example Kittiwake species parameters
spdat <- get_example_spdat()

# Inspect the available parameters
names(spdat)
#>  [1] "Code"             "Species"          "BM_adult_mn"      "BM_adult_sd"     
#>  [5] "BM_adult_mortf"   "BM_adult_abdn"    "BM_chick_mn"      "BM_chick_sd"

#> [21] "energy_prey"      "energy_nest"      "energy_flight"    "energy_searest"
